displayedInputs.question: A truck has a load capacity of 4 tonnes and has already been loaded with 1 tonne. How many more tonnes can it carry? Calculate: \(4-1=\)?
Two warehouses have 368 boxes and 475 boxes, respectively. How many boxes are there in total? Calculate: \(368+475=\)?
After completing written addition, what method is commonly used to check the answer?

choices.A: Use subtraction: subtract one addend from the sum and check whether the result equals the other addend.
choices.B: Multiply the two addends together again.
choices.C: Look only at the ones column and ignore the other place values.

displayedInputs.question: There are 600 books on a bookshelf, and 248 books are moved away. How many books remain? Calculate: \(600-248=\)?
Each box contains 7 red flowers, and there are 5 boxes in total. How many flowers are there altogether? Calculate: \(7\times5=?\)
Each box of colored pens costs 36 yuan. You buy 4 boxes. How many yuan do they cost altogether? Calculate: \(36\times4=?\)
Each box contains 105 items. How many items are there in 4 boxes altogether? Calculate: \(105\times4=?\)
What are number codes used for?

choices.A: Representing things with numbers so they are easy to distinguish

displayedInputs.question: A two-digit number has 2 in the tens place and 5 in the ones place. What is the number?
Numbers are assigned from 1 to 30. How many numbers are assigned in total? Calculate: \(30-0=?\)

choices.A: The length of the boundary all the way around a shape
choices.B: The size of the region inside a shape

displayedInputs.question: A rectangle is 6 centimeters long and 4 centimeters wide. What is its perimeter in centimeters?
A square has a side length of 5 centimeters. What is its perimeter in centimeters?
A rectangular vegetable plot is 8 meters long and 3 meters wide. What is the minimum length of fencing needed in meters? Calculate: \((8+3)\times2=?\)
What does the denominator of a fraction represent?

choices.A: The number of equal parts into which the whole is divided
choices.B: The number of parts taken away

displayedInputs.question: A sheet of paper is divided into 8 equal parts, and 1 part is shaded. What fraction of the sheet is shaded? Use \(1\div8\) to represent each part. Calculate: \(1\div8=?\) (Answer as a decimal.)
\(2/8\) of a rope is used, and then another \(3/8\) is used. What fraction is used in total? Calculate: \(2/8+3/8=?\)
